description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid ranged attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Linked Materia Mode III (Lightning, Earth)], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Dynamite Duo Mode] to the user

description.name: Rising Cleave
description.text: Six single ranged hybrid attacks (0.90/1.00/1.15 or 3.05/3.40/3.90 each) capped at 9999/19999/29999 if the user has Pro Mentality level 0/1/2+, causes Pro Mentality -1/-2 to the user if the user has Pro Mentality level 1/2+

description.name: Earth Wave
description.text: Three single ranged hybrid attacks (0.80 or 2.70), grants [Buff Earth 10% (15s)] and [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)] to the user

description.name: Linked Materia Mode III (Lightning, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Earth ability

description.name: Dynamite Duo Mode
description.text: Casts Charged Bolt after another ally uses an Earth or Lightning ability, removed after triggering ten times

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
